title: Assistant Professor & equivalent (Faculty of Agriculture & Faculty of Community Science) and other posts
qualification: Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture/ Horticulture/ Community Science/Veterinary Science as relevant to the requirement of the post. age_limit: The upper age limit for the post of Assistant Professor & equivalent is 38 years as on the last date of submission of the application.
